chemistry-killer-02.title: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa
chemistry-killer-02.topic: Kuchengetedzwa kwemass, mutemo wehuwandu hwakagara, kuburitsa nekutora kupisa
chemistry-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-02.material:
Pakupisa nepressure zvakagadzikana, haidrojeni ($\mathrm{H_2}$) inopindura neoksijeni ($\mathrm{O_2}$) kuumba mhute yemvura ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Masanganiswa egasi akasiyana akapindurwa zvizere uye huwandu hwose hwevhoriyamu yegasi hwakayerwa pakupisa nepressure zvakafanana (mvura yose iri gasi).
(A) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL -> huwandu hwose mushure mereaction 35 mL
(B) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL -> huwandu hwose mushure mereaction 30 mL
Sanganiswa ye 60 mL ye $\mathrm{H_2}$ ne $\mathrm{O_2}$ yakapindurwa zvizere pakupisa nepressure zvakafanana. Huwandu hwose mushure mereaction hwaiva 45 mL uye gasi rega rakasara raiva $\mathrm{O_2}$ (hapana $\mathrm{H_2}$ yasara). Ndeipi peya inopa nemazvo vhoriyamu ye $\mathrm{H_2}$ pamberi pereaction nevhoriyamu ye $\mathrm{O_2}$ yasara mushure mereaction, nenzira iyoyo?

chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.prompt:
Pakupisa nepressure zvakagadzikana, haidrojeni ($\mathrm{H_2}$) inopindura neoksijeni ($\mathrm{O_2}$) kuumba mhute yemvura ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Masanganiswa egasi akasiyana akapindurwa zvizere uye huwandu hwose hwevhoriyamu yegasi hwakayerwa pakupisa nepressure zvakafanana (mvura yose iri gasi).
(A) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL -> huwandu hwose mushure mereaction 35 mL
(B) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL -> huwandu hwose mushure mereaction 30 mL
Sanganiswa ye 60 mL ye $\mathrm{H_2}$ ne $\mathrm{O_2}$ yakapindurwa zvizere pakupisa nepressure zvakafanana. Huwandu hwose mushure mereaction hwaiva 45 mL uye gasi rega rakasara raiva $\mathrm{O_2}$ (hapana $\mathrm{H_2}$ yasara). Ndeipi peya inopa nemazvo vhoriyamu ye $\mathrm{H_2}$ pamberi pereaction nevhoriyamu ye $\mathrm{O_2}$ yasara mushure mereaction, nenzira iyoyo?
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.explain:
Nhanho 1: Kubva ku (A) ne (B) reshiyo yavhoriyamu. (B): 20 mL ye H2 inopindura ne 10 mL ye O2 kupa 20 mL ye H2O, 10 mL ye O2 yasara, huwandu hwose 30 mL. (A): 30 mL ye H2 inopindura ne 15 mL ye O2 kupa 30 mL ye H2O, 5 mL ye O2 yasara, huwandu hwose 35 mL. Saka $\mathrm{H_2:O_2:H_2O(g)} = 2:1:2$.
Nhanho 2: Vhoriyamu inodzika kubva ku 60 mL kusvika ku 45 mL, kudzikira kwe 15 mL. Reaction imwe neimwe ye mavhoriyamu 3 kuita 2 inorasikirwa nevhoriyamu 1, yakaenzana nevhoriyamu ye $\mathrm{O_2}$ yakapindura, saka $\mathrm{O_2}$ yakapindura = 15 mL.
Nhanho 3: Hapana $\mathrm{H_2}$ yasara, saka H2 yakapindura = 15 x 2 = 30 mL, H2O(g) = 30 mL. Huwandu hwose mushure = 45 mL, saka $\mathrm{O_2}$ yasara = 45 - 30 = 15 mL. $\mathrm{O_2}$ yekutanga = 15 + 15 = 30 mL, uye 30 + 30 = 60 mL inobvumirana.
Pindura: 30 mL, 15 mL (b).
